apps.description:
Read-only Android ROS 2/DDS inspector with native Dashboard, Explore, Graph and Logs, themes, four telemetry watches, numeric plots/CSV and one LaserScan/camera reader.

Version1.4 adds offline URDF/CAD assets, bounded full indexed GLES2, passive observed TF, fullscreen and resizable/reorderable dashboard cards. Assets bind to the exact robot description; no robot commands, RPC or arbitrary mesh downloads.

ARM64 Android9+. Explicit LAN or routed VPN setup and manual Humble/Jazzy graph format. Production1.4 was host-built/linted/signed; the separate DEV variant received bounded physical-tablet and software-simulation observation. Production physical, sustained FPS/battery, real VPN absence/return and RF/IP recovery remain unqualified.

This is the independent upstream repository, not the official f-droid.org catalogue. APKs retain the upstream production certificate used by GitHub releases.
apps.summary: Read-only ROS 2 and DDS inspection on Android

en-US.description:
ROS Pocket is a read-only ROS 2/DDS inspector for Android phones and tablets.

Connect on the same IPv4 Wi-Fi/LAN, select the ROS domain and the manual Humble or Jazzy graph format, then inspect:
• Topic types, publishers, subscribers, endpoint QoS and announced ROS nodes.
• Up to four live topic watches with counters, received rate and data age.
• Numeric plots with pause and CSV export of retained real samples.
• A dedicated rosout console and structured standard messages.
• Bounded LaserScan and Image/CompressedImage views.
• Saved connection/watch/plot/sensor profiles with JSON import/export.

The application speaks DDS directly; it does not require rosbridge or a cloud account. It sends no robot commands, parameter writes, service requests or teleoperation commands. Internet permission is needed for local network sockets; there are no ads or analytics.

Limitations: ARM64, Android 9 or newer, IPv4 LAN or explicit routed VPN networking and a defined set of standard message types. Graph format selection is manual; mixed distributions and all RMW/network/device combinations are not guaranteed. Native node/topic graph, themes and editable dashboard are available. Offline URDF/CAD and passive observed TF provide bounded visual context, not a full RViz or calibrated robot model. Physical Wi-Fi/IP disruption/recovery remains unqualified. Numeric retention is bounded and is not a lossless recorder or rosbag replacement.

This is a bench engineering tool, not a safety instrument. The production package installs separately from ROS Pocket DEV; their signatures and private data are not interchangeable.
en-US.name: ROS Pocket
en-US.summary: Inspect ROS 2 topics, telemetry, plots and logs directly over DDS
en-US.whatsNew: Offline URDF/CAD assets, passive observed TF and fullscreen. Resize and reorder dashboard cards with local persistence. Read-only DDS; no robot commands.

pt-BR.description:
ROS Pocket é um inspetor ROS 2/DDS somente leitura para celulares e tablets Android.

Conecte na mesma rede IPv4 Wi-Fi/LAN, selecione o domínio ROS e o formato manual de grafo Humble ou Jazzy. Inspecione tópicos, tipos, publicadores/assinantes, QoS e nós anunciados; acompanhe quatro watches, gráficos numéricos com pausa e CSV, rosout, mensagens estruturadas e visualizações limitadas de LaserScan ou Image/CompressedImage. Salve e transporte configurações por perfis JSON.

DDS direto, sem rosbridge, conta na nuvem, anúncios ou analytics. A permissão de Internet permite sockets de rede local. O app não envia comandos ao robô nem escreve parâmetros ou invoca serviços/teleop.

Limites: ARM64, Android 9+, IPv4 em LAN ou VPN roteada explícita e tipos padrão definidos. Formato do grafo é manual; não há garantia de todas as combinações ROS/RMW/rede/dispositivo. Grafo nativo nó→tópico→nó, temas e painel editável estão disponíveis. URDF/CAD offline e TF passivo fornecem contexto visual limitado, não RViz completo nem modelo calibrado. Interrupção e recuperação física de Wi-Fi/IP continuam não qualificadas. Retenção numérica é limitada, não gravação sem perdas nem rosbag.

Ferramenta de bancada, não instrumento de segurança. O pacote de produção instala ao lado do ROS Pocket DEV, sem compartilhar assinatura ou dados privados.
